additional_info.subject: RE: ID0484023-DC/Si-D/AT-[Multi] Missing screws CRM:02889001311
additional_info.body:
Hi Johannes,
I am reaching out in regards of this old ticket
ID0484023.
The ticket was opened to report missing screws in the delivery of new chargers, required for installation.
I had a conversation with Tobias from QM department, and he informed me that:
No 8D report is required for such case.
He will make sure with Factory that screws will be included in the delivery of new chargers.
He will send you a bag of spare screws for RC-AT use.
Since no further action is required form service side and the issue has been already reported to responsible contacts, I will proceed to close this ticket.
With kind regards,
Fosco Servidei
